archetypes.name: scoring-integrity
archetypes.rationale: Weighted scoring crosses producers, TSV readers, and progress aggregation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the weighted review-point scoring path end to end. Check that only YES-voter vN_severity cells affect in-scope accepted weights, that OOS and legacy no-scope TSV rows stay flat, and that count columns and pruning remain unweighted. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: attribution-scope
archetypes.rationale: Attribution splitting differs between design and implement classification columns.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on reviewer attribution and scope filtering. Verify finding_reviewers uses human-label tokenization, reviewer_slots uses pipe splitting with implement display-label normalization, and explicit scope=oos excludes Top reviewers even without an OOS_ id. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
